ResearchProjectDef.label: pinball engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Solenoids, relay logic, scoring reels and a sheet of tempered glass. Lets you build coin-op amusement tables - including the boomalope blitz and, with a little microelectronics, the solid-state mech rampage table.

ResearchProjectDef.label: holographic entertainment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Volumetric emitters small enough to sit inside a games cabinet. Unlocks the hologame pod and the archotech dreamtable, which projects a pinball that flatters whoever is holding the flippers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: dreamloop projection
ResearchProjectDef.description: Room-filling shared projection: a waking dream an entire colony can sit in at once. Unlocks the dreamloop holotheater.
